title: Real Madrid sweep Valencia, claim second straight Liga Endesa title
description: Valencia - Real Madrid 70-81 Real Madrid clinched the second consecutive Liga Endesa title. They beat Valencia on the road tonight to sweep the Finals. The guests trailed by 1 point at the halftime before their 42-30 charge in the second half, which allowed them to win the game. Great defensive blocking was one of the keys in this match when Real Madrid made 9 blocks. The best player for the winners was Croatian Mario Hezonja (202-1995) who scored 16 points and 9 rebounds. Argentinian point guard Facundo Campazzo (181-1991) chipped in 9 points and 8 assists. At the other side the best for losing team was the former international Xabier Lopez-Arostegui (200-1997) who recorded 14 points and Dominican guard Jean Montero (188-2003) added 12 points and 5 rebounds (went 8 for 8 at the free throw line) respectively.
